output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    if not any(8 in r for r in grid): return out
    sep=None
    for i,row in enumerate(grid):
        if row and all(x==5 for x in row): sep=i; break
    if sep is None or sep==0: return out
    src=None
    for i in range(sep+1,len(grid)):
        if any(x!=0 for x in grid[i]): src=i; break
    if src is None:return out
    from collections import Counter
    c=Counter(grid[src])
    for j,x in enumerate(grid[src]):
        if x!=0 and c[x]==1: out[sep-1][j]=x
    return out"}
